import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query NO2 and PM2.5 data for October 2025, categorized by station type and time of day
# Rush hour: 7-9 and 17-19, Off-peak: all other hours
query = text("""
SELECT 
    aqs.station_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) IN (7, 8, 17, 18) THEN 'rush_hour'
        ELSE 'off_peak'
    END as time_period,
    AVG(hsaq.no2) as avg_no2,
    AVG(hsaq.pm2_5) as avg_pm25,
    COUNT(*) as reading_count
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY aqs.station_type, time_period
ORDER BY aqs.station_type, time_period
""")
result_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result_df)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query hourly data for roadside stations in October 2025
# October 2025: from 2025-10-01 00:00:00 to 2025-11-01 00:00:00 (exclusive)
query = text("""
SELECT station_id, datetime, no2, pm2_5, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM datetime) as hour
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id IN (17, 16, 14)
AND datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
AND no2 IS NOT NULL
AND pm2_5 IS NOT NULL
AND pm2_5 > 0
ORDER BY datetime
""")
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Total records: {len(df)}")
print(df.head(10))

import pandas as pd

# Define rush hours: 08:00-09:00 (hour 8), 17:00-19:00 (hours 17, 18)
rush_hours = [8, 17, 18]

# Define off-peak hours: 00:00-05:00 (hours 0,1,2,3,4), 10:00-15:00 (hours 10,11,12,13,14)
offpeak_hours = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14]

# Calculate NO2/PM2.5 ratio for each reading
df['no2_pm25_ratio'] = df['no2'] / df['pm2_5']

# Filter for rush hours
rush_df = df[df['hour'].isin(rush_hours)]
offpeak_df = df[df['hour'].isin(offpeak_hours)]

print(f"Rush hour records: {len(rush_df)}")
print(f"Off-peak hour records: {len(offpeak_df)}")

# Calculate average ratio for each period
rush_ratio = rush_df['no2_pm25_ratio'].mean()
offpeak_ratio = offpeak_df['no2_pm25_ratio'].mean()

print(f"Rush hour average NO2/PM2.5 ratio: {rush_ratio:.4f}")
print(f"Off-peak hour average NO2/PM2.5 ratio: {offpeak_ratio:.4f}")

# Round to 2 decimal places
rush_ratio_rounded = round(rush_ratio, 2)
offpeak_ratio_rounded = round(offpeak_ratio, 2)

print(f"Rush hour ratio (rounded): {rush_ratio_rounded}")
print(f"Off-peak ratio (rounded): {offpeak_ratio_rounded}")

# Store the results in the required variables
